# Lists

## Inherited bullets and decimal delimiters

```````````````````````````````` example
- a
+ b
* c

3. d
4. e

1) f

0. z
.
Document scope=1:1..10:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=6
├── List scope=1:1..1:3 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null delimiter=null tight=true children=1
│   └── ListItem scope=1:1..1:3 anchor=null attributes={} status=null children=1
│       └── Paragraph scope=1:3..1:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│           └── Text scope=1:3..1:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a" children=0
├── List scope=2:1..2:3 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null delimiter=null tight=true children=1
│   └── ListItem scope=2:1..2:3 anchor=null attributes={} status=null children=1
│       └── Paragraph scope=2:3..2:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│           └── Text scope=2:3..2:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b" children=0
├── List scope=3:1..4:0 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null delimiter=null tight=true children=1
│   └── ListItem scope=3:1..4:0 anchor=null attributes={} status=null children=1
│       └── Paragraph scope=3:3..3:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│           └── Text scope=3:3..3:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="c" children=0
├── List scope=5:1..7:0 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=ordered start=3 delimiter=period tight=true children=2
│   ├── ListItem scope=5:1..5:4 anchor=null attributes={} status=null children=1
│   │   └── Paragraph scope=5:4..5:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │       └── Text scope=5:4..5:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="d" children=0
│   └── ListItem scope=6:1..7:0 anchor=null attributes={} status=null children=1
│       └── Paragraph scope=6:4..6:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│           └── Text scope=6:4..6:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="e" children=0
├── List scope=8:1..9:0 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=ordered start=1 delimiter=parenthesis tight=true children=1
│   └── ListItem scope=8:1..9:0 anchor=null attributes={} status=null children=1
│       └── Paragraph scope=8:4..8:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│           └── Text scope=8:4..8:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="f" children=0
└── List scope=10:1..10:4 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=ordered start=0 delimiter=period tight=true children=1
    └── ListItem scope=10:1..10:4 anchor=null attributes={} status=null children=1
        └── Paragraph scope=10:4..10:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
            └── Text scope=10:4..10:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="z" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## The inherited decimal ceiling

```````````````````````````````` example
123456789. nine

1234567890. ten
.
Document scope=1:1..3:15 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── List scope=1:1..2:0 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=ordered start=123456789 delimiter=period tight=true children=1
│   └── ListItem scope=1:1..2:0 anchor=null attributes={} status=null children=1
│       └── Paragraph scope=1:12..1:15 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│           └── Text scope=1:12..1:15 anchor=null attributes={} literal="nine" children=0
└── Paragraph scope=3:1..3:15 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=3:1..3:15 anchor=null attributes={} literal="1234567890. ten" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
- a
+ b
* c
.
Document scope=1:1..3:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
├── List scope=1:1..1:3 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null delimiter=null tight=true children=1
│   └── ListItem scope=1:1..1:3 anchor=null attributes={} status=null children=1
│       └── Paragraph scope=1:3..1:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│           └── Text scope=1:3..1:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a" children=0
├── List scope=2:1..2:3 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null delimiter=null tight=true children=1
│   └── ListItem scope=2:1..2:3 anchor=null attributes={} status=null children=1
│       └── Paragraph scope=2:3..2:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│           └── Text scope=2:3..2:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b" children=0
└── List scope=3:1..3:3 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null delimiter=null tight=true children=1
    └── ListItem scope=3:1..3:3 anchor=null attributes={} status=null children=1
        └── Paragraph scope=3:3..3:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
            └── Text scope=3:3..3:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="c" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
3. a
4. b

1) c

0. z
.
Document scope=1:1..6:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
├── List scope=1:1..3:0 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=ordered start=3 delimiter=period tight=true children=2
│   ├── ListItem scope=1:1..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} status=null children=1
│   │   └── Paragraph scope=1:4..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │       └── Text scope=1:4..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a" children=0
│   └── ListItem scope=2:1..3:0 anchor=null attributes={} status=null children=1
│       └── Paragraph scope=2:4..2:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│           └── Text scope=2:4..2:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b" children=0
├── List scope=4:1..5:0 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=ordered start=1 delimiter=parenthesis tight=true children=1
│   └── ListItem scope=4:1..5:0 anchor=null attributes={} status=null children=1
│       └── Paragraph scope=4:4..4:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│           └── Text scope=4:4..4:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="c" children=0
└── List scope=6:1..6:4 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=ordered start=0 delimiter=period tight=true children=1
    └── ListItem scope=6:1..6:4 anchor=null attributes={} status=null children=1
        └── Paragraph scope=6:4..6:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
            └── Text scope=6:4..6:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="z" children=0
````````````````````````````````

Only decimal markers are ordered: Pandoc's letters, Roman numerals, `#` and
both-sided parentheses are text, and a list nested in an item may start at
any number.

```````````````````````````````` example
a. x

A) x

(i) x

IV. x

#. x

(1) x

- x
  2. y
.
Document scope=1:1..14:6 anchor=null attributes={} children=7
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   └── Text scope=1:1..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a. x" children=0
├── Paragraph scope=3:1..3:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   └── Text scope=3:1..3:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="A) x" children=0
├── Paragraph scope=5:1..5:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   └── Text scope=5:1..5:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="(i) x" children=0
├── Paragraph scope=7:1..7:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   └── Text scope=7:1..7:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="IV. x" children=0
├── Paragraph scope=9:1..9:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   └── Text scope=9:1..9:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="#. x" children=0
├── Paragraph scope=11:1..11:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   └── Text scope=11:1..11:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="(1) x" children=0
└── List scope=13:1..14:6 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null delimiter=null tight=true children=1
    └── ListItem scope=13:1..14:6 anchor=null attributes={} status=null children=1
        └── Paragraph scope=13:3..14:0,14:3..14:6 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
            ├── Text scope=13:3..13:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="x" children=0
            ├── SoftBreak scope=13:4..14:0 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
            └── Text scope=14:3..14:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="2. y" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
para
2. x

para
b. x

para
1. x
.
Document scope=1:1..8:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=4
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..2:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
│   ├── Text scope=1:1..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="para" children=0
│   ├── SoftBreak scope=1:5..2:0 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
│   └── Text scope=2:1..2:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="2. x" children=0
├── Paragraph scope=4:1..5:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
│   ├── Text scope=4:1..4:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="para" children=0
│   ├── SoftBreak scope=4:5..5:0 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
│   └── Text scope=5:1..5:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b. x" children=0
├── Paragraph scope=7:1..7:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   └── Text scope=7:1..7:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="para" children=0
└── List scope=8:1..8:4 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=ordered start=1 delimiter=period tight=true children=1
    └── ListItem scope=8:1..8:4 anchor=null attributes={} status=null children=1
        └── Paragraph scope=8:4..8:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
            └── Text scope=8:4..8:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="x" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Ownership and boundary regressions
